title: The Emperor's arrival
description: The Rebel Fleet will fail in its mission to obliterate the Death Star if the space station's protective shield generator on Endor is not deactivated. Han Solo and Leia enlist the aid of their new Ewok allies in an effort to wrest control of the shield, in which both sides take turns having the advantage. Meanwhile, Admiral Ackbar and the ready-for-action Alliance fleet emerge from hyperspace, but discover that the Death Star shield is still up. As the Rebels contemplate their options, the Imperial armada, which was supposedly far away, appears from out of nowhere and an intense space battle begins. Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker finally confronts Emperor Palpatine face-to-face on the Death Star...
